arcs.name: Opening a Dream 🍲
arcs.intro: Rosie opens her first restaurant in Bellwindport.

episodes.author: Rosie Pan
episodes.text: I'm almost ready to open my restaurant! I still have so much to do.
episodes.translation: もうすぐ自分のお店がオープンする！まだやることがいっぱい。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: You can do it, Rosie!
replies.translation: ロージー、きっとできるよ！

replies.author: Nova Orbit
replies.text: What is a restaurant opening?
replies.translation: レストランの開店って何？

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: Come visit and find out!
replies.translation: 来てみたらわかるよ！

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: Will you have coffee on the menu too?
replies.translation: コーヒーもメニューに入る？

episodes.author: Rosie Pan
episodes.text: The sign is up! We're opening this Saturday. I'm so nervous!
episodes.translation: 看板がついた！今週土曜日にオープンするよ。すごく緊張する！

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: I'll be there for lunch!
replies.translation: ランチに行くね！

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: Coffee first. Then lunch.
replies.translation: まずコーヒー。それからランチ。

replies.author: Ollie
replies.text: Do you have a lucky apron for opening day?
replies.translation: 開店日のための幸運のエプロンってある？
replies.easyText: Do you have a lucky apron?

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: Only one covered in flour!
replies.translation: 小麦粉だらけのしかないよ！

episodes.author: The Chirp Times
episodes.text: LOCAL NEWS: Rosie Pan will open Rosie's Kitchen in Bellwindport this Saturday. The owner has been preparing for months.
episodes.translation: 地元ニュース：Rosie Panさんの「Rosie’s Kitchen」が今週土曜日、Bellwindportに開店予定。店主は数か月にわたり準備を進めてきました。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: Will they have coffee?
replies.translation: コーヒーはあるかな？

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: It's near my office!
replies.translation: 職場の近くだ！

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: Yes, we have coffee. And soup!
replies.translation: はい、コーヒーもスープもあります！
replies.easyText: Yes, we have coffee. And soup!

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.text: I hope they have seats by the window.
replies.translation: 窓際の席があるといいな。

episodes.author: Rosie's Kitchen
episodes.text: WE ARE OPEN! Today we have tomato soup, fresh bread, and a lot of happy nerves.
episodes.translation: オープンしました！今日はトマトスープと焼きたてパン、そしてドキドキがいっぱいです。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: The bread smells amazing!
replies.translation: パンがすごくいい匂い！

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: Thank you for coming, Mika!
replies.translation: ミカ、来てくれてありがとう！

replies.author: Nova Orbit
replies.text: Is soup a drink?
replies.translation: スープは飲み物ですか？

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: That bread sounds like the perfect lunch.
replies.translation: そのパンは最高のお昼ごはんになりそう。

episodes.author: Mika Reed
episodes.text: I tried the new restaurant near my office. Rosie's soup is so good!
episodes.translation: 職場の近くの新しいレストランに行ってきた。Rosieのスープ、すごくおいしい！

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: This made my day. Thank you!
replies.translation: 今日いちばんうれしい！ありがとう！
replies.easyText: This made my day. Thank you!

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.text: I'll try it this weekend.
replies.translation: 今週末行ってみるよ。

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: You picked the soup! That makes me happy.
replies.translation: スープを選んでくれたのね！嬉しいな。

replies.author: Ollie
replies.text: I wonder how many tomatoes are in one bowl.
replies.translation: 一杯にトマトがいくつ入っているのかな。

episodes.author: Rosie Pan
episodes.text: I tried making a new pasta dish. I made a huge mess. The kitchen survived.
episodes.translation: 新しいパスタを試作したら、キッチンが大変なことに。なんとか無事でした。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: Did the pasta survive?
replies.translation: パスタは無事だった？

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: Most of it. 😂
replies.translation: 大部分はね。😂

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: The best experiments leave a messy kitchen.
replies.translation: 最高の実験は台所を散らかすものさ。

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: Next time I will use a bigger pan.
replies.translation: 次はもっと大きなフライパンを使うわ。

episodes.author: Rosie's Kitchen
episodes.text: Help us choose our next special: spicy curry or chocolate pancakes?
episodes.translation: 次のおすすめを選んでね。スパイシーカレー、それともチョコレートパンケーキ？

replies.author: Nova Orbit
replies.text: Why not both?
replies.translation: 両方じゃダメなの？

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: Please do not give me ideas!
replies.translation: 余計なアイデアを出さないで！
replies.easyText: Please do not give me ideas!

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: I vote for something warm after a late gig.
replies.translation: 遅いライブのあとには温かいものに一票。

replies.author: Ollie
replies.text: Can a pancake be spicy?
replies.translation: パンケーキって辛くできるのかな？

episodes.author: Rosie Pan
episodes.text: We sold out of soup today! I need a bigger pot.
episodes.translation: 今日はスープが売り切れた！もっと大きな鍋が必要だわ。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: Good problem to have!
replies.translation: うれしい悲鳴だね！

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: True! My feet disagree.
replies.translation: そうね！足は反対してるけど。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: I missed the last bowl!
replies.translation: 最後の一杯を逃しちゃった！

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: I promise to make more tomorrow.
replies.translation: 明日はもっと作ると約束するよ。

episodes.author: Bellwindport Transit
episodes.text: NOTICE: A small delay on the Harbor Line this afternoon. Please allow extra time.
episodes.translation: お知らせ：本日午後、ハーバー線で小規模な遅延が発生しています。時間に余裕を持ってください。

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: My bread delivery is on that train!
replies.translation: パンの配達がその電車なの！
replies.easyText: My bread delivery is on that train!

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: I can help carry some supplies.
replies.translation: 材料運びなら手伝えるよ。
replies.easyText: I can help carry some supplies.

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: You are a lifesaver!
replies.translation: 本当に助かる！

replies.author: Ollie
replies.text: I will bring a book for the wait.
replies.translation: 待ち時間用に本を持っていこう。

episodes.author: Rosie's Kitchen
episodes.text: A little thank-you dinner this Friday! We made it through our first week together.
episodes.translation: 金曜日に小さな感謝のディナーを開きます！みんなのおかげで最初の1週間を乗り切れました。

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.text: Can I bring my sax?
replies.translation: サックス持っていってもいい？

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: Only if you play something cheerful!
replies.translation: 明るい曲を演奏してくれるなら！
replies.easyText: Only if you play something cheerful!

replies.author: Nova Orbit
replies.text: I will bring my human disguise.
replies.translation: 人間用の変装を持っていきます。
replies.easyText: I will bring my human disguise.

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: Does the thank-you dinner include dessert?
replies.translation: 感謝ディナーにはデザートも付く？

arcs.name: A Little Apology 🎷
arcs.intro: Jazz Cat tries to repair a friendship.

episodes.author: Jazz Cat
episodes.text: I had a bad argument with a friend. I don't know what to say now.
episodes.translation: 友達とひどい口論をしてしまった。今、何を言えばいいかわからない。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: Give yourself some time.
replies.translation: 少し時間をとって。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: Do you want to talk?
replies.translation: 話したい？

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: Give yourselves a little time to cool down.
replies.translation: お互い少し落ち着く時間を取ってね。

replies.author: Ollie
replies.text: Could one short message help?
replies.translation: 短いメッセージが役に立つかな？

episodes.author: Jazz Cat
episodes.text: I think I was too harsh yesterday. I should say sorry.
episodes.translation: 昨日は言いすぎたと思う。謝らなきゃ。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: It's not easy, but you can do it.
replies.translation: 簡単じゃないけど、できるよ。
replies.easyText: It's not easy, but you can do it.

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.text: Thanks. I'm still scared.
replies.translation: ありがとう。でもまだ怖いよ。

replies.author: Tenor Turtle
replies.text: You can start with a simple hello.
replies.translation: まずは簡単な挨拶から始めてみたら。

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.text: I think I can do that.
replies.translation: それならできそう。

episodes.author: Jazz Cat
episodes.text: I finally sent the message. Now I'm waiting.
episodes.translation: ようやくメッセージを送った。今は返事を待ってる。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: That took courage.
replies.translation: 勇気が要ったね。

replies.author: Nova Orbit
replies.text: Waiting is a strange human sport.
replies.translation: 待つというのは奇妙な人間のスポーツですね。
replies.easyText: Waiting is a strange human sport.

replies.author: Ollie
replies.text: Waiting for an answer takes courage too.
replies.translation: 返事を待つのにも勇気がいるよね。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: Try playing something while you wait.
replies.translation: 待っている間に何か演奏してみたら。

episodes.author: Jazz Cat
episodes.text: We talked. We both made mistakes. I feel a little better.
episodes.translation: 話ができた。お互いに間違いがあった。少し気持ちが楽になった。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: I'm glad you talked.
replies.translation: 話せてよかったね。

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.text: Me too. Thank you.
replies.translation: 僕もそう思う。ありがとう。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: Listening is sometimes the hardest part.
replies.translation: 話を聞くのが一番難しいこともあるよね。

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.text: But it was worth it.
replies.translation: でも、話してよかった。

episodes.author: Jazz Cat
episodes.text: My friend and I played music together again. It felt like home.
episodes.translation: 友達とまた一緒に演奏した。帰ってきたような気分だった。

replies.author: Tenor Turtle
replies.text: Music helps us talk.
replies.translation: 音楽は会話の助けになるよね。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: Now that is good news.
replies.translation: それはいいニュースだ。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: Music makes a good second beginning.
replies.translation: 音楽はやり直しのよいきっかけになるね。

replies.author: Tenor Turtle
replies.text: What did you two play?
replies.translation: 二人で何を演奏したの？

episodes.author: Nova Orbit
episodes.text: Today I learned that humans talk about the weather when they have nothing to say.
episodes.translation: 今日は、人間は話題がないときに天気の話をすると学びました。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: It is a friendly way to start.
replies.translation: 親しく話し始める方法なんだよ。
replies.easyText: It is a friendly way to start.

replies.author: Nova Orbit
replies.text: So... nice weather?
replies.translation: では……いい天気ですね？

replies.author: Ollie
replies.text: Sometimes weather is an easy way to say hello.
replies.translation: 天気の話は挨拶のきっかけになることもあるね。

replies.author: Nova Orbit
replies.text: I shall study more clouds.
replies.translation: もっと雲を研究するとしよう。

episodes.author: Nova Orbit
episodes.text: I tried saying “nice weather” during a storm. People looked confused.
episodes.translation: 嵐の日に「いい天気ですね」と言ってみました。みんな困惑していました。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: Maybe check the sky first. 😂
replies.translation: まず空を見たほうがいいかも。😂

replies.author: Nova Orbit
replies.text: Noted. Sky first.
replies.translation: 記録しました。まず空。

replies.author: Rainy Rabbit
replies.text: Next time try asking about umbrellas.
replies.translation: 次は傘について聞いてみたら？

replies.author: Ollie
replies.text: The timing matters more than the words!
replies.translation: 言葉そのものよりタイミングが大事なんだね！

episodes.author: Nova Orbit
episodes.text: I made a new friend today. We talked about clouds for ten minutes.
episodes.translation: 今日は新しい友達ができました。雲について10分間話しました。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: That sounds lovely.
replies.translation: それは素敵だね。

replies.author: Bookish Fox
replies.text: Ten minutes of cloud talk sounds lovely.
replies.translation: 10分間の雲談義、素敵ね。

replies.author: Nova Orbit
replies.text: We named three cloud shapes.
replies.translation: 雲の形に3つ名前を付けた。

arcs.name: Mika Visits Eastmere 🚆
arcs.intro: Mika travels from Bellwindport, explores Eastmere, and makes new musical friends.

episodes.author: Mika Reed
episodes.text: My suitcase is ready. Tomorrow, I leave Bellwindport for Eastmere!
episodes.translation: スーツケースの準備ができた。明日、ベルウィンドポートからイーストミアへ出発！
episodes.easyText:
My bag is ready.
I travel tomorrow.

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.text: Bring your lucky mouthpiece!
replies.translation: 幸運のマウスピースも持っていって！

replies.author: Ollie
replies.text: I wonder how many train lines Eastmere has.
replies.translation: イーストミアには鉄道路線がいくつあるんだろう。

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: I will save you some soup for your return.
replies.translation: 帰ってきたらスープを取っておくよ。

episodes.author: Mika Reed
episodes.text: I am at Bellwindport Airport. Which gate is mine? The signs are confusing.
episodes.translation: ベルウィンドポート空港にいる。私の搭乗口はどこ？案内表示がややこしい。
episodes.easyText:
Where is my gate?
I am lost.

replies.author: Tenor Turtle
replies.text: Check your ticket. You have time.
replies.translation: チケットを確認して。まだ時間はあるよ。

replies.author: Ollie
replies.text: Does the airport have a helpful information desk?
replies.translation: 空港に案内カウンターはあるかな？

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: Found it! The gate is upstairs.
replies.translation: 見つけた！搭乗口は上の階だった。

episodes.author: Mika Reed
episodes.text: I made it to Eastmere! Neonbridge Station is huge. I took the wrong exit twice.
episodes.translation: イーストミアに着いた！ネオンブリッジ駅は巨大。出口を二度も間違えた。
episodes.easyText:
This station is huge!
I am lost again.

replies.author: Lily Pop
replies.text: Welcome! Look for Exit Four.
replies.translation: ようこそ！4番出口を探して。

replies.author: Chloe Spark
replies.text: Neonbridge has exits that surprise everyone.
replies.translation: ネオンブリッジの出口は誰でも迷うよ。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: I think I walked in a circle.
replies.translation: ぐるっと一周した気がする。

episodes.author: Chloe Spark
episodes.text: Mika and I found a tiny cafe near the Neonbridge towers. She ordered the largest coffee.
episodes.translation: ミカとネオンブリッジのビル街の小さなカフェへ。彼女は特大コーヒーを注文した。
episodes.easyText:
Mika is here!
We got coffee.

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: The cup is almost as big as my sax case.
replies.translation: カップがサックスケースくらい大きいよ。

replies.author: Lily Pop
replies.text: Did you try their cinnamon rolls?
replies.translation: あそこのシナモンロール食べた？

replies.author: Chloe Spark
replies.text: Next visit! Mika found a tiny music shop nearby.
replies.translation: 次回こそ！ミカは近くに小さな楽器店を見つけたよ。

episodes.author: Mika Reed
episodes.text: Willow Lane is quiet in the morning. An old shopkeeper waved, and a cat followed me down the street.
episodes.translation: 朝のウィローレーンは静か。古い店の人が手を振ってくれて、猫が通りをついてきた。
episodes.easyText:
Willow Lane is quiet.
A cat followed me.

replies.author: Chloe Spark
replies.text: That cat greets everyone.
replies.translation: あの猫はみんなに挨拶するの。

replies.author: Ollie
replies.text: Did the cat lead you to a secret street?
replies.translation: 猫が秘密の道に案内してくれたのかな？

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: It led me to a bakery instead.
replies.translation: 代わりにパン屋さんへ連れていかれたよ。

episodes.author: Mika Reed
episodes.text: Cloverstonemill has record stores, old games, and a little live house. Lily showed me her favorite street.
episodes.translation: クローバーストーンミルにはレコード店、レトロゲーム、小さなライブハウス。リリーがお気に入りの通りを案内してくれた。
episodes.easyText:
I found old records.
Lily knows this street.

replies.author: Lily Pop
replies.text: We should hear a band tonight!
replies.translation: 今夜バンドを聴きに行こうよ！

replies.author: Ollie
replies.text: Did the old games still work?
replies.translation: 昔のゲームはまだ動いたのかな？

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: I found a jazz album I had never heard.
replies.translation: 聴いたことのないジャズのアルバムを見つけた。

episodes.author: Mika Reed
episodes.text: Harmony Street is full of instrument shops! I tried three saxophone mouthpieces and lost track of time.
episodes.translation: ハーモニー・ストリートは楽器店だらけ！サックスのマウスピースを三つ試して、時間を忘れた。
episodes.easyText:
So many instrument shops!
I tried three mouthpieces.

replies.author: Clara Strings
replies.text: There is a wonderful violin shop here too.
replies.translation: ここにはすてきなバイオリン店もあるよ。

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.text: Did you test a really low note?
replies.translation: すごく低い音も試した？
replies.easyText: Did you try a low note?

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: The third mouthpiece sounded surprisingly warm.
replies.translation: 3つ目のマウスピースは驚くほど温かい音だった。

episodes.author: Clara Strings
episodes.text: Tonight I am playing at Brookside Concert Hall. Mika came all the way from Bellwindport to listen.
episodes.translation: 今夜ブルックサイド・コンサートホールで演奏するの。ミカがベルウィンドポートから聴きに来てくれた。
episodes.easyText:
My concert is tonight.
Mika is coming.

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: The hall sounds beautiful. Good luck, Clara!
replies.translation: 響きがきれいなホールだね。クララ、頑張って！

replies.author: Ollie
replies.text: What does the hall sound like before anyone plays?
replies.translation: 誰も演奏していない時のホールってどんな響きなんだろう？

replies.author: Clara Strings
replies.text: I always take one deep breath before I begin.
replies.translation: 始める前には必ず一度深呼吸するの。

episodes.author: Mika Reed
episodes.text: After the concert, Clara and I walked beside Brookside River. We talked about music and home.
episodes.translation: コンサート後、クララとブルックサイドの川沿いを散歩した。音楽と故郷の話をした。
episodes.easyText:
We walked by the river.
We talked about music.

replies.author: Clara Strings
replies.text: Next time, bring your sax. We can play together.
replies.translation: 次はサックスを持ってきて。一緒に演奏しよう。

replies.author: Ollie
replies.text: Did the river change how the music felt afterward?
replies.translation: 川辺だと演奏の余韻も変わるのかな？

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: It made everything feel peaceful.
replies.translation: 何もかも穏やかに感じられたよ。

episodes.author: Mika Reed
episodes.text: Back in Bellwindport at last. My suitcase is heavier, my heart is full, and I have new friends in Eastmere.
episodes.translation: ようやくベルウィンドポートに帰宅。スーツケースは重くなり、胸はいっぱい。イーストミアに新しい友達ができた。
episodes.easyText:
I am home!
I made new friends.

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.text: Welcome back! Tell us everything.
replies.translation: おかえり！話を全部聞かせて。

replies.author: Lily Pop
replies.text: Come back to Cloverstonemill sometime!
replies.translation: またクローバーストーンミルに来てね！

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: Bellwindport missed you. Dinner at my place?
replies.translation: ベルウィンドポートは寂しかったよ。うちで夕食どう？

arcs.name: Bellwindport Harbor Festival 🎉
arcs.intro: A warm neighborhood festival with jazz, food stalls, games and visitors from Eastmere.

episodes.author: Rosie Pan
episodes.text: The harbor festival starts soon. My kitchen will have a little food stand!
episodes.translation: 港のお祭りがもうすぐ始まる。うちのお店も小さな屋台を出すよ！
episodes.easyText: The festival starts soon. I will cook there!

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: Save me a sandwich! I have rehearsals all day.
replies.translation: サンドイッチを取っておいて！一日中リハーサルなんだ。

replies.author: Ollie
replies.text: Do festivals smell different in every town?
replies.translation: お祭りって街ごとに違う匂いがするのかな？

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: I will need something warm after the train ride.
replies.translation: 電車の旅のあとには温かいものが欲しいな。

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: Then come before the line gets long!
replies.translation: なら行列が長くなる前に来てね！

episodes.author: Coffee Goblin
episodes.text: I took the early train to Bellwindport. There are lights all along the harbor!
episodes.translation: 早い電車でベルウィンドポートに来た。港沿いがずっとライトで飾られてる！
episodes.easyText: I came to Bellwindport. So many lights!

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: Come find my stand near the small blue boat.
replies.translation: 小さな青い船の近くにある屋台に来てね。

replies.author: Ollie
replies.text: You made it! Which stall will you visit first?
replies.translation: 着いたね！最初にどの屋台へ行く？

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: More like glowing cups of coffee.
replies.translation: 光るコーヒーカップみたいだよ。

episodes.author: Mika Reed
episodes.text: Sound check is done. The wind keeps stealing my sheet music!
episodes.translation: 音響チェックが終わった。風が譜面を何度も飛ばしていく！
episodes.easyText: Sound check is done. It is windy!

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.text: I'll guard the music stand. Probably.
replies.translation: 譜面台は守るよ。たぶんね。

replies.author: Clara Strings
replies.text: Try a few clips. Outdoor stages can be tricky.
replies.translation: クリップを使ってみて。野外ステージって難しいよね。

replies.author: Ollie
replies.text: Maybe the wind wants a solo.
replies.translation: 風もソロを吹きたいのかも。

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.text: I can hold the music stand!
replies.translation: 譜面台を押さえてあげるよ！

episodes.author: Lily Pop
episodes.text: The harbor is full of music! I heard jazz, then a rock band, then a children's choir.
episodes.translation: 港じゅう音楽でいっぱい！ジャズ、ロックバンド、子どもたちの合唱まで聴いたよ。
episodes.easyText: So much music! I love this festival!

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: I could hear the choir from backstage. They were great!
replies.translation: 舞台裏まで合唱が聞こえたよ。素敵だった！

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: I found good coffee beside the game stalls.
replies.translation: ゲーム屋台の隣でおいしいコーヒーを見つけた。

replies.author: Clara Strings
replies.text: I heard the children singing from the bridge.
replies.translation: 橋から子どもたちの合唱が聞こえたよ。

replies.author: Lily Pop
replies.text: Their last song made everyone clap along!
replies.translation: 最後の歌ではみんな手拍子していたよ！

episodes.author: Rosie Pan
episodes.text: The festival is over, and I'm exhausted. We sold every last sandwich. Thank you, Bellwindport!
episodes.translation: お祭りが終わってくたくた。サンドイッチは全部売り切れ！ベルウィンドポートのみんな、ありがとう！
episodes.easyText: The festival is over. We sold out!

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: You fed half the band. We owe you!
replies.translation: バンドの半分にご飯をくれたよね。恩がある！

replies.author: Ollie
replies.text: The empty stalls make the harbor feel quiet again.
replies.translation: 屋台がなくなると、港がまた静かに感じるね。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: Same time next year? I'll bring a bigger cup.
replies.translation: 来年も同じ時期？今度はもっと大きいカップを持ってくるよ。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: Your sandwiches kept the musicians going.
replies.translation: あなたのサンドイッチのおかげで演奏者は元気だったよ。
